Home / Client Success / Audiophile E-Commerce

Audiophile E-Commerce

Premium audio equipment e-commerce platform with multi-step checkout, product filtering, responsive image galleries, and cart persistence.

React Redux Stripe API Responsive Design
// the challenge

Business Challenge

This internal project explored the full complexity of e-commerce user flows - product discovery, filtering, cart management, and multi-step checkout - with particular focus on cart state persistence and responsive product image galleries.

// our approach

Engineering Approach

Engineered as a React/Redux application with a normalised product data store. The checkout flow implements a multi-step form with validation at each stage, address autocomplete, and Stripe payment integration. Product galleries use progressive image loading with responsive srcset definitions, ensuring fast load times across device sizes. Cart state persists via localStorage with optimistic UI updates.

Business Results & Metrics

  • Multi-Step Checkout Flow
    Complete checkout pipeline with form validation, address autocomplete, and payment processing - demonstrating production-grade e-commerce patterns.
  • Cart State Persistence
    localStorage-backed cart with optimistic updates, surviving page refreshes and browser sessions.
  • Responsive Product Galleries
    Progressive image loading with srcset/sizes attributes, delivering optimal image resolution across all viewports.
